overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to address staff reports, consider licensing and financial matters, and review significant planning and budgetary items including a preliminary subdivision plat, zoning code amendments, and the 2027 budget preview with a 10-year capital improvements program.

agenda.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report
Finance Director/Treasurer Report - Monthly Report and August 2026 Financial Statements (Budget Status Report)
August 2026 Financial Statistical Report from Wisconsin Policy Forum
August 2026 Check Register, ACH Register, and Credit Card Transactions Activity
Green Tree Trails Subdivision Preliminary Plat
Text Amendment of Chapter 520 of the General Code of Ordinances: Zero Lot Line Structures
2027 Budget Preview - State Aids Listing, Refuse/Recycling Fee, and Debt Service Fund Tax Levy
2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget - 2nd Draft: Focus on Funding Sources

discussions.item: Green Tree Trails Subdivision Preliminary Plat
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to discuss and consider action on the preliminary plat for the Green Tree Trails subdivision development. This item was set for review as part of the land development approval process.

discussions.item: Text Amendment of Chapter 520 of the General Code of Ordinances: Zero Lot Line Structures
discussions.body: The Board was expected to consider a text amendment to the village ordinances regarding zero lot line structures. This zoning code modification was set for discussion and possible action.

The Board was scheduled to review the 2027 budget preview including state aids listings, proposed refuse/recycling fees, and debt service fund tax levy considerations. This preliminary review was set to inform discussions ahead of formal budget adoption.

The Board was expected to examine the second draft of the 10-year capital improvements program with a focus on funding sources. This item was scheduled to guide long-term infrastructure and financial planning decisions.
The Board was scheduled to consider and act on an operator bartender license application for Michelle Gee. This licensing matter was set for approval or denial as part of consent agenda items.

The Finance Director was scheduled to present monthly financial statements, budget status reports, and a financial statistical analysis comparing Kronenwetter to other North Central Wisconsin communities. These reports were set to provide fiscal oversight and accountability.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person, at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
